name: re_match_all
title: Extract all regular expression matches into a data frame

origin.description: Returns every match in list columns. An input that misses is an empty list, not NA.
origin.details: Returns every match in list columns. An input that misses is an empty list, not NA.
origin.value: re_match_all of "  Ben Franklin and Jefferson Davis" returns first names Ben and Jefferson.
origin.example: re_match_all("  Ben Franklin and Jefferson Davis", "(?<first>[[:upper:]][[:lower:]]+) (?<last>[[:upper:]][[:lower:]]+)")
